entries.text: Idea: adding a secondary processor core dedicated entirely to telemetry tunes for the little dart
Read "M17 Project – Bringing good stuff since 2019": they got a tiny radio chip running a fast-paced surface game at nineteen frames per second.
clicking through m17 project specs on the comms tower terminal
entries.why: i want to see how open radio protocols handle digital framing before i finish the radio stack.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "M17 Project Specs on the Wire"
Idea: add an open-source comms relay board to the little dart's avionics bay.
Read "M17 Digital Voice: How the Open Amateur Mode Works": m17 uses an open protocol so anyone can build gear without paying a single credit.
spec.m17project.org wouldn't open, so he tried ly4a.com instead.
tapping a metallic rhythm while reading specs on the comms dish
entries.why: i want to see how the m17 protocol packs deep space calls into small bitstreams.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Reading up on M17 packets!"
Idea: adding an m17 compatible digital voice codec to the little dart's comms array
Read "M17: a native 4-FSK / Codec2 digital-voice coding chain – Patrick Lidstone": m17 uses 4-fsk at 4800 symbols per second for clean digital voice without proprietary chips.
rolling up to the comms tower to search the wire for codec2 links
entries.why: i want to figure out how to route those voice packets straight into the panel.
